stem: Arnav rewrites $8 - (-3)$ by replacing subtraction with addition of an additive inverse.

options.text: $8 - (-3) = (-8) + (-3)$, applying the inverse to the first integer.
$8 - (-3) = 8 + (+3)$, because subtracting $-3$ is adding the additive inverse of $-3$.
Call the step addition only, with no inverse stated.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Subtracting an integer is the same as adding its additive inverse, so 8−(−3) becomes 8+(+3).

teacher.key_rationale: Subtracting −3 is adding the additive inverse of −3, which is +3. Applying the inverse to the minuend, or naming addition with no inverse, misses that replacement.
